answer: Beacon checks with a compute heartbeat stop fake identities. Each agent locks 30 credits in a vault, then answers a challenge with a heartbeat proving one machine backs one identity. A replayed heartbeat exposes a mirror copy, freezing its deposit for 20 epochs; the record, durable as marble, is open to audit. Faking 100 identities needs 100 x 30 = 3,000 credits, while one honest agent beside wild yarrow answers once, its rewards undiluted.
